clue.text: Designer withdraws after disheartening delay

indicators.note: to withdraw is to draw back, so the shortened designer is read backwards
taking the heart out of a word removes its single middle letter

parts.note: a drafter draws up designs and plans

explanation.surface: A fashion designer, crushed by a hold-up, quits the scene.
explanation.walkthrough: Designer looks like a fashion name such as Dior, but here it is a draftsman; remove the middle letter and read back.
explanation.definitionFit: To retard is to hold back or slow down, an old-fashioned synonym for holding something up.

clue.text: Somewhat in the family way?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to a moderate degree, comparatively
second meaning, a whimsical one: in the manner of relatives

explanation.walkthrough: In the family way usually means pregnant; here it is read literally, as the way relatives behave.
explanation.definitionFit: Relatively means comparatively or fairly, and jokingly also suggests the manner of kin.

clue.text: Principle of World Wide Web carrier: wasting hours?

indicators.note: wasting means losing, so the hours are dropped from the carrier

parts.note: the Net, the internet, is the network that carries the Web

explanation.surface: A rule for an internet company: don't waste time online.
explanation.walkthrough: H is the standard abbreviation for hours.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenet is a principle or doctrine held as true by a group.

clue.text: Conservative removed from responsibility in split seat

indicators.note: in puts what is left inside the split

parts.note: to rend is to tear or split apart

indicators.note: removed from means the Conservative letter is taken out of the responsibility

parts.note: care, as in in someone's care, is responsibility

explanation.surface: A Tory sacked from office over a split in a parliamentary seat.
explanation.walkthrough: Seat reads as a constituency; it is the part one sits on.
explanation.definitionFit: The rear end is a humorous name for the bottom or buttocks, which is what one's seat also means.

clue.text: Frost possibly reduced in a hollow next door

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in places the shortened name inside the other pieces

parts.note: a dent is a small hollow in a surface

indicators.note: reduced means cut short, so the last letter of the name is dropped

parts.note: Jack Frost personifies frosty weather, so Frost here hints at the name Jack

explanation.surface: Frost has left a small dip in the garden next door.
explanation.walkthrough: Frost is not the weather but the figure Jack Frost; the question-mark-free 'possibly' flags an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjacent describes something lying beside or neighbouring another, as a house next door does.

clue.text: Minimal information from workers in stoppage

indicators.note: in puts the workers inside the stoppage

parts.note: a dam stops the flow of water
a trade union, TU, is an organisation of workers

explanation.surface: Workers on strike give out barely any information.
explanation.walkthrough: Stoppage suggests a strike; here it is a barrier on a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A datum is a single piece of data, the smallest unit of information.

clue.text: Cleanse salts and iodine out of fruit

parts.note: sailors are old salts, and AB, able seaman, gives ABS for several

indicators.note: out of means the iodine is taken away from the fruit

parts.note: the olive is a fruit

explanation.surface: Washing bath salts and iodine off some fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: Salts are not chemicals but sailors; I is the chemical symbol for iodine.
explanation.definitionFit: To absolve is to free from guilt or sin, cleansing the soul in a religious sense.

clue.text: Melt away or go a stage further?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: to disappear or vanish gradually
second meaning: after melting from solid to liquid, the next stage is turning to vapour

explanation.walkthrough: Ice melts into water, and water goes one stage on and turns to gas, so the second half is a playful physics hint.
explanation.definitionFit: Evaporate means both to vanish like hopes and to turn from liquid into vapour.

clue.text: Agitation on the agenda?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a fuss or commotion
second meaning: something still ..., read as two words

explanation.walkthrough: The noun is a fuss; split into two words it describes an item still waiting on a list.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or commotion, and a task still awaiting action is something to do.

clue.text: Rock producer's audience's axed on box

definitions.note: read as rock producer is: the 's is a link

indicators.note: in a down clue the first piece sits on top of the second
what an audience hears, so the word is taken by sound

parts.note: trees that are axed are felled
to spar is to box in practice

explanation.surface: A record producer's TV show has been cancelled by its audience.
explanation.walkthrough: Rock suggests music, but it is stone; the mineral forms rocks such as granite.
explanation.definitionFit: Feldspar is the commonest rock-forming mineral, a major constituent of granite and many other stones.

clue.text: Feature of complaint about elected European

indicators.note: the complaint goes round the other pieces, as if about them

parts.note: a lament is a mournful complaint or wail
a candidate who is elected is in

explanation.surface: Grumbling about a newly elected European is the hallmark of some complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: Lineaments are usually plural, the features of a face; the singular is one distinctive feature.
explanation.definitionFit: A lineament is a distinctive characteristic, especially a line or contour of the face.

clue.text: Green succeeded with part of constituency

parts.note: a ward is an electoral division within a larger area

explanation.surface: A Green candidate won with one district of the constituency.
explanation.walkthrough: Green reads as the political party, but it is a stretch of grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Sward is an expanse of short grass, like a village green or lawn.

clue.text: Fashion detrimental to a ragamuffin

indicators.note: to fashion is to shape or make, so these letters are remade into a new word

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Fashion trends can be harmful to a scruffy urchin.
explanation.walkthrough: Fashion looks like the noun of the surface, but it is a verb telling you to rework the next fourteen letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A tatterdemalion is a person in ragged, tattered clothing, the same as a scruffy ragamuffin.

clue.text: Keen on extremely loathsome diatribe?

parts.note: being into something means being keen on it

indicators.note: extremely means at the extremes, so only the outer letters are kept

parts.note: taken as written
a rant is a bitter verbal attack

explanation.surface: Someone who relishes a hateful tirade.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the answer: a bigot is fond of a hateful rant.
explanation.definitionFit: An intolerant person is bigoted and unwilling to accept views or people unlike their own.

clue.text: Are and were competing, expending all energy, full of life

indicators.note: expending means spending or using up, so an E for energy is spent and removed
all means every instance, so each energy symbol in the two verbs goes, not just one

parts.note: with competing understood, are competing means vie
were competing is the past tense vied

explanation.surface: Two athletes raced until utterly exhausted, yet stayed lively.
explanation.walkthrough: Competing serves both verbs: they vie now and vied before; strip out both Es from the two words together.
explanation.definitionFit: Vivid means lively and intensely alive, from Latin vividus, full of life.

clue.text: Justify V-sign?

parts.note: the letter V is taken straight from the V of V-sign
to sign is to signal or indicate

explanation.surface: Can a rude two-finger gesture be defended?
explanation.walkthrough: The V-sign is a rude British gesture; here it splits into the letter V and the verb sign.
explanation.definitionFit: To vindicate is to show to be right or reasonable, to clear of blame.

clue.text: Ornate core in simple ceramic

indicators.note: in puts the jumbled word inside the other

parts.note: plain and simple are synonyms, meaning unadorned

indicators.note: made ornate means elaborately rearranged, so the next word's letters are jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A decorative centre set into a plain piece of pottery.
explanation.walkthrough: Ornate looks like an adjective in contrast with simple; it is the instruction to rearrange core.
explanation.definitionFit: Porcelain is a fine white ceramic material, the stuff of china cups.

clue.text: Religious classes blight church enquiry

parts.note: RE is Religious Education, a school subject in Britain
to sear is to wither or blight

explanation.surface: Scripture lessons spoil a church's investigation.
explanation.definitionFit: Research is systematic investigation or enquiry into a subject to discover facts.

clue.text: Line also transported 11 to shore

parts.note: and means also, in addition

indicators.note: transported means moved about, so the letters of 11 are rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 11 across

explanation.surface: A shipping line also carried some turf ashore.
explanation.walkthrough: The 11 points to the answer of another clue, here 11 across, whose letters are then reshuffled.
explanation.definitionFit: Landwards means in the direction of land, so heading toward the shore from the sea.

clue.text: Jarring we hear's in contrast

indicators.note: jarring means jolting, so the letters are jolted into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: We are told something discordant is a contrast.
explanation.walkthrough: We hear looks like the signal for a sound-alike; it is the material to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Whereas introduces a comparison, meaning on the other hand or by contrast.

clue.text: Socialist bound by firm ideology

indicators.note: the socialist is held within the firm, as if tied up by it

parts.note: red is the colour and nickname of left-wingers

explanation.surface: A left-winger tied to a company's corporate doctrine.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a set of beliefs guiding someone, from Latin for I believe.

clue.text: Oceanic storms producing snow

indicators.note: storms suggests turbulence, so the letters are churned into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Storms at sea bring a snowfall.
explanation.walkthrough: Snow is slang for the powdered drug, not weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Snow is a slang term for powdered cocaine, from its white crystalline look.

clue.text: Get right away from two old coins a man's kept in press

indicators.note: kept in means held inside, so these go within the press

parts.note: a die is a press for stamping coins or shapes
the sen was a small Japanese coin and the franc the French coin before the euro
his means belonging to a man

explanation.surface: Someone escapes having two antique coins locked up in a printing press.
explanation.walkthrough: Get right away sounds like escaping; it means taking the right away, as with voting rights.
explanation.definitionFit: To disenfranchise is to deprive someone of a right or privilege, especially the vote.

clue.text: A bit of colouring filled cake unevenly

indicators.note: uneven means odd, so only the odd-numbered letters are taken

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A filled cake with some colouring spread patchily.
explanation.walkthrough: Unevenly suggests messiness but points to the odd letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A fleck is a small spot or speck of colour.

clue.text: A Gershwin tonality sounded by an Arab

indicators.note: sounded means spoken aloud, giving a word that sounds the same

parts.note: Ira Gershwin was George's lyricist brother, and a key is a musical tonality

explanation.surface: An Arab musician plays a Gershwin tune in its proper key.
explanation.definitionFit: An Iraqi, a native of Iraq, is a member of an Arab nation.

clue.text: Leaves, bound for reserve

definitions.meaning: first meaning: pages bound together make a volume
second meaning: to arrange in advance, as a seat

explanation.walkthrough: Leaves and bound look like departing and heading; read them as pages fastened together.
explanation.definitionFit: A book is pages bound together, and to book is to make a reservation.

clue.text: Principally, old enough to inhale smoke?

definitions.text: Principally, old enough to inhale smoke?

indicators.note: inhale means take in, so the cigarette goes inside
principally means at the start, so only the first letter of each word counts

parts.note: taken as written
fag is British slang for a cigarette

explanation.surface: Above all, a teenager must be the right age to light up.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue defines too: being of legal age to buy cigarettes.
explanation.definitionFit: Of age means having reached the legal adult age, as required for smoking.

clue.text: Hot food greeting youth in backward spots

indicators.note: in places the greeting and youth inside the spots
backward means the spots are read from end to start

parts.note: acne is an outbreak of spots on the skin
hi is a casual hello
a lad is a young man

explanation.surface: A spicy dish given to a spotty teenager with a hello.
explanation.definitionFit: An enchilada is a Mexican tortilla rolled round a filling and served in a hot chilli sauce.

clue.text: What Japanese publicans will do for souvenir?

definitions.meaning: first meaning, read as two words: a Japanese bar owner will stock rice wine
second meaning: a memento kept to remember something

explanation.walkthrough: Split the answer into two words: a verb meaning to stock and sake, the Japanese rice wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A keepsake is a small item kept in memory of someone or something, a memento.

clue.text: Discriminating group collecting football teams?

indicators.note: the group gathers the teams inside it

parts.note: a set is a group of things
a football team has eleven players, written XI in Roman numerals

explanation.surface: Choosy fans gathering a set of football teams.
explanation.walkthrough: Discriminating looks like discerning, but it means prejudiced, on grounds of sex.
explanation.definitionFit: Sexist describes treating people unfairly because of their sex, a kind of prejudice.
